Dear Tailspin Team,

Your billing record has been corrected, and a refund of **175** has been processed for the overcharged seats. Your correct seat allocation is now **2,504** (previously **2,679**).

As per our retention policy **RP-14**, your account details were securely archived to ensure data integrity.

**Next Steps:**
- The refund will reflect in 3-5 business days.
- Verify your dashboard for the updated seat count.

Please confirm receipt of this email to close the ticket. If you have any questions, reply to this message.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team

---
